home.title: Home
home.subtitle: Photograph a meter, type a number, or add food.
auth.login.title: Log in
auth.login.description: If this email already has an account, we send a one-time login link. New here? Create an account first. After you open a link, this phone stays signed in.
auth.login.remember_hint: We only email a login link if this address already has an account. You only need a new link on a new phone, or after you log out.
auth.login.demo_hint: Uses :email on this computer. No email is sent.
appearance.heading: Appearance settings
appearance.description: Colours, text size, and read aloud for this phone.
appearance.large_text_hint: Makes words and buttons bigger on this phone.
appearance.read_aloud_hint: This phone speaks saved numbers and today’s summary. Speech stays on this device. Off by default. Press Escape to stop.
appearance.language_hint: This phone. A helper and the person whose log this is can each pick their own.
food.intro: Your numbers after these foods. Check with your clinic.
food.hint: After 5 times of the same food with a 2-hour sugar reading, a comparison appears here.
food.photo_hint: After you log this food 5 times with a 2-hour sugar reading, your own average will show here.
food.clinic_range: Clinic sugar range on this log: :low–:high :unit.
